title: Days of Sorrow and Famine After the Lord's Word
description: The Lord warns that the festivals will turn to sorrow and the songs into lamentation. The people shall dress in sackcloth and mourn as for an only son. Days of famine are coming to the land—not a famine of bread or water, but of hearing the words of the Lord. People will wander from sea to sea seeking the word of the Lord, but they will not find it.
